## My Grandtour of Switzerland Photo Spots

```{=html}


<style>

#map-grandtour { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 100%; }


.mapboxgl-marker {
    cursor: pointer;
    opacity: 0.8 !important;
}

.marker-hover {
    transform: scale(1.3);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3));
    opacity: 1 !important; /* Override default opacity on hover */
}

#grandtour-card-title {
    font-size: 1.5em;
    /* font-weight: bold; */
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    font-family: 'Style Script', cursive;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      /* Add some spacing between the image and text */
    
}

#grandtour-card {
    position: relative;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    width: 90%;
    max-width: 300px;
    background: white;
    z-index: 10;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    padding: 20px;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0.95;
    align-items: center;
}

#grandtour-card.hidden {
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}
#grandtour-card-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    
}

.grandtour-image-container {
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    width: 200px;
    aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;
    overflow: visible;
    border-radius: 8px; /* Optional: add rounded corners to the image container */
}

.grandtour-photo,
.grandtour-frame {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.grandtour-photo{
    z-index: 21;
    opacity: 1;
}

.grandtour-frame {
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 22; /* Optional: add rounded corners to the photo */
}

.btn-reset {
    cursor: pointer;
    background: #495057;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    margin: 3em 0 0 0;
}

.btn-reset:hover {
    background: #EA291C;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}




/* MOBILE RESPONSIVENESS */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .map-container {
        height: 550px; /* Smaller height for mobile screens */
    }
    #grandtour-card {
        max-width: 230px;
    }
    #grandtour-card-title {
        font-size: 1.4em;
    }
}
</style>


<div class="map-container">
<div id="map-grandtour"></div>



<div id="grandtour-card" class="hidden">
    
  <div id="grandtour-card-content">
    
    <h2 id="grandtour-card-title"></h2>
    <div id="grandtour-image-container" class="grandtour-image-container"></div>
    <button class="btn-reset" onclick="resetMap();" id="grandtour-card-close">Close</button>
  </div>

  
</div>

</div>
<script src="grandtour.js"></script>

```


------

The geographical coordinates of the photo spots come from [Switzerland Tourism](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/experience-tour/car-motorcycle-grand-tour/experiences-along-the-grand-tour-search/?dynamiccampaigntypes=photospot).

Photos are taken by [Wenyu Liu](https://wenyuliu.ch/).

The coat of arms of Swiss cantons are provided by [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_and_arms_of_cantons_of_Switzerland) under [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Main_Page).
